document.title: Rules of Procedure of the OIC Council of Foreign Ministers
document.purpose: Defines how the OIC Council of Foreign Ministers is organized, conducts meetings, debates, voting, and adopts decisions.

definitions.members_present_and_voting: Only members who cast Yes or No votes

rules.title: Definitions
summary: These rules govern the Council of Foreign Ministers.
They may also apply to other OIC meetings unless separate rules exist.
The Summit may also use these rules.

rules.title: Convening the Council
summary: Regular session is held once every year.
Normally between April and June.
Hosted by member states using geographical rotation.
Minimum gap between regular sessions is 11 months.
Secretary General sends invitations at least 3 months before.
If host cannot organize, another venue or Jeddah headquarters is used.
Meeting may be postponed under exceptional circumstances.
Virtual meetings are allowed in exceptional cases.

rules.title: Quorum
summary: Two-thirds of member states are required for quorum.
Expert meetings do not require quorum.

rules.title: Open and Closed Sessions
summary: Opening session is public.
Chair decides whether other sessions are open or closed after consulting members.

rules.title: Extraordinary Meetings
summary: Can be requested by a Member State or Secretary General.
Requires simple majority approval.
Notice normally sent one week before.

rules.title: Election of Bureau
summary: Bureau consists of Chairman, three Vice-Chairmen, Rapporteur, and Secretary General.
Palestine is permanent Vice-Chair.
Host country chairs the meeting.

rules.title: Powers of Bureau
summary: Handles procedural matters.
Advises Chairman.
Coordinates meeting management.
Does not negotiate political or legal issues.

rules.title: Preparatory Meetings
summary: ICECS, PFC and Senior Officials Meeting are held before Council.
Council may establish Special Committee.
Schedules coordinated with Chairmanship.

rules.title: Draft Agenda
summary: Prepared by Secretary General.
Sent one month before preparatory meetings.
Includes annual report, previous decisions, member proposals and Secretary General proposals.
Palestine and Jerusalem remain permanent agenda items.
Draft resolutions submitted two weeks before meeting.

rules.title: Supplementary Agenda
summary: Members may add urgent items at least 15 days before meeting.
Must include explanation.
Supplementary agenda shared at least 10 days before.

rules.title: Agenda for Extraordinary Sessions
summary: Only discusses issues for which session was called.
Agenda sent five days before.

rules.title: Secretary General Duties
summary: Participates in all meetings.
Provides studies and clarification.
Organizes Secretariat work.
Coordinates with host country.

rules.title: Chairman's Duties
summary: Presides over meetings.
Controls speaking order.
Maintains order.
Rules on points of order.
May limit speaking time.
Does not vote.

rules.title: Experts and Institutions
summary: Council may invite experts or institutions.
Member States are informed one week before.

rules.title: Proposals
summary: Proposals must be written.
Include financial impact and implementation method.
Normally circulated before discussion.

rules.title: Adjournment and Closure
summary: Chair or Member State may propose postponement or closure.
Decision made by consensus or two-thirds majority.

rules.title: Priority of Motions
priority_order: Refer issue to committee or Secretary General

rules.title: Voting
summary: Each Member State has one vote.
States may explain votes.
Members owing two years' contributions normally lose voting rights.

rules.title: Adoption of Resolutions
summary: Consensus is preferred.
Otherwise requires two-thirds majority.
Procedural matters require simple majority.
Rejected proposals cannot normally be reconsidered during same session.

rules.title: Method of Voting
summary: Usually by show of hands.
Roll-call if requested.
Secret ballot possible with required approval.

rules.title: Election of Secretary General
summary: Elected by consensus or secret ballot.
Requires two-thirds majority.
Replacement follows geographical rotation.

rules.title: Abstention and Reservation
summary: Members may abstain.
Reservations are officially recorded.

rules.title: Amendment of Proposals
summary: Amendments voted before original proposal.
Accepted amendments become part of proposal.

rules.title: Rejection of Proposal
summary: Tie vote allows second vote.
Second tie means proposal is rejected.
Proposal may be divided into separate parts for voting.

rules.title: Circulation of Documents
summary: Resolutions circulated within two weeks.
Draft minutes shared within two weeks.
Final reports issued within one month.

rules.title: Publication
summary: Resolutions and recommendations are published unless Council decides otherwise.

rules.title: Amendment of Rules
summary: Changes proposed four months in advance.
Major amendments circulated two months before.
Adopted by consensus or two-thirds majority.

rules.title: Entry into Force
summary: Rules become effective immediately after approval by consensus or two-thirds majority.
